en.name: Nelly Perkins Rodelo
en.intro: Technical Support Lead · QA & Testing · Front-End Development · Illustration
profile: Multidisciplinary digital creative and technical support lead with extensive experience in second-line support, software quality assurance, partner training and knowledge base documentation. I combine technical troubleshooting and clear communication with front-end development and a strong eye for visual design. Experienced in working across support, product and development teams to identify issues, document solutions and improve the quality and usability of digital products.

details: Investigate technical issues, identify patterns and work with development and product teams on bugs, workarounds and product limitations.
Write and maintain support documentation and knowledge base content; prepare and deliver partner training.
Create detailed bug reports and support testing workflows using tools including Jira, Cucumber and Zendesk.
Provided customer support via Zendesk, chat and telephone in Spanish and English.
Created documentation for customers, partners and new colleagues; onboarded and mentored new team members.
Collaborated with illustration and web design teams on work for international clients.
Led a small creative team and oversaw design work for international and national client accounts.
